title: Type the remaining serde_json::Value /query comparators
description: Follow-up from JMAP-wf92.22 (JMAP-wf92.11 verify). These QueryObjects still use type Comparator = serde_json::Value: Calendar, CalendarEventNotification, ParticipantIdentity (calendars-types/src/backend.rs), Mailbox, EmailSubmission (mail-types), Principal, ShareNotification (sharing-types), TaskList (tasks-types), FileNode (filenode-types). CHANGELOG and AGENTS.md now name them as outside the typed-comparator rule. Decide whether to give each a typed XxxComparator with an Other(String) catch-all per AGENTS.md 'Exception: comparator sort properties'.
notes:
Freeze audit (2026-10-22) survivor 3/3 adds client-shape divergence:

## [JMAP-wf92.25] Untyped /query sort arguments also differ in client shape (Option<Value> vs Option<&[Value]>)
Crates: jmap-mail-client, jmap-filenode-client, jmap-calendars-client, jmap-sharing-client
Evidence: crate-jmap-mail-client/src/methods/mailbox.rs:239,309 and crate-jmap-filenode-client/src/methods/filenode.rs:549,618 take `sort: Option<serde_json::Value>`, a whole array passed as one Value. crate-jmap-calendars-client/src/methods/event_notification.rs:215,276 takes `sort: Option<&[serde_json::Value]>`. Every typed sibling takes `Option<&[XxxComparator]>`. JMAP-wf92.25 tracks the types-side Comparator = serde_json::Value, and this is the matching client-signature divergence.
Why breaking later: When wf92.25 lands typed comparators, each of these client signatures changes anyway. Doing it in the same 0.4 pass avoids a second break.
Fix: When implementing wf92.25, move every client query/query_changes sort argument to `Option<&[XxxComparator]>`, with the slice shape everywhere.
Size: S
